title: OpenPencil: an open-source, AI-native alternative to Figma
description:
What if AI could design your UI for you — in real time? OpenPencil is an open-source, AI-native alternative to Figma. Instead of dragging boxes for hours, it runs an MCP server in the background so you can open Claude Code and literally type: 'generate a rover management dashboard using the editorial style guide' — and watch the AI place and style components on your canvas live. Ships with a gallery of professional style guides.

https://github.com/open-pencil/open-pencil

#github #opensource
